Name: Seasonal Haystacks Silo Reskin (CP)
Author: eorrl
Description:
Hey!

This is a content patcher mod that makes your silos appear as haystacks, with optional seasonal varieties. It should be unzipped directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder. After launching the game, a config file will be generated. You can then set "Silo" to "Basic", "Seasonal", or "Vanilla". If you have Generic Mod Config Menu by spacechase0 installed, you could instead use that to configure this mod, without restarting the game.

Image above shows, in order: Basic, Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter.

Hope you enjoy! :)

- Eorrl
